recipe.build:
RUSTUP="1.29.0"
pushd haha_note_src
source build_script/versions.sh
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b $RUSTUP
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/haha_note_src/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN --target armv7-linux-androideabi --target aarch64-linux-android --target i686-linux-android --target x86_64-linux-android
source $HOME/.cargo/env
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s*\^?([0-9.]*)/\1/p' pubspec.yaml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache NO_SIGNING=true
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
find . -name '*.apk'
mkdir reproducible-apk-tools
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_REPRO_APK_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C reproducible-apk-tools/
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-align --pad-like-apksigner --replace build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
RUSTUP="1.29.0"
pushd haha_note_src
source build_script/versions.sh
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b $RUSTUP
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/haha_note_src/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN --target armv7-linux-androideabi --target aarch64-linux-android --target i686-linux-android --target x86_64-linux-android
source $HOME/.cargo/env
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s*\^?([0-9.]*)/\1/p' pubspec.yaml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache NO_SIGNING=true
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
find . -name '*.apk'
mkdir reproducible-apk-tools
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_REPRO_APK_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C reproducible-apk-tools/
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-align --pad-like-apksigner --replace build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
RUSTUP="1.29.0"
pushd haha_note_src
source build_script/versions.sh
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b $RUSTUP
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/haha_note_src/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN --target armv7-linux-androideabi --target aarch64-linux-android --target i686-linux-android --target x86_64-linux-android
source $HOME/.cargo/env
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s*\^?([0-9.]*)/\1/p' pubspec.yaml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache NO_SIGNING=true
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
find . -name '*.apk'
mkdir reproducible-apk-tools
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_REPRO_APK_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C reproducible-apk-tools/
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-align --pad-like-apksigner --replace build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
